name: Relic Retriever

abilities.text: At the beginning of each end step, if a card left your graveyard this turn, create a Treasure token.

notes: APPROXIMATION: no condition asks whether a card left your graveyard this turn, so the end-step trigger is turned inside out - a card leaving your graveyard sets up a delayed trigger at the beginning of the next end step that creates the Treasure. Deviation: two cards leaving your graveyard in one turn set up two delayed triggers and make two Treasures, where the card makes one per end step (see needs).
